mapper.select: select id, activity_id, member_id, draw_count, last_draw_time, create_time, update_time from biz_lottery_member where activity_id = #{activityId} and member_id = #{memberId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into biz_lottery_member ( activity_id, member_id, draw_count, last_draw_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{activityId}, #{memberId}, #{drawCount}, #{lastDrawTime}, sysdate(), sysdate() ) on duplicate key update draw_count = values(draw_count), last_draw_time = values(last_draw_time), update_time = sysdate()
